cohort: Women who gave birth at a major Australian tertiary maternity hospital
finding: Women with high EPDS scores (≥ 12) experienced poorer intrapartum and neonatal outcomes, including higher rates of category 1 caesarean sections, pre-term birth, low birth weight, low Apgar scores, resuscitation at birth, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Category 1 caesarean sections were more common in women with EPDS scores ≥12 (5.2% vs. 4.3%, OR 1.24 95% CI 1.03-1.49, p = 0.024).
